reviews.title: It is comfortable
reviews.comment: This chair is a really good chair it just was not high enough for me. I did not return it because it is a nice chair and if i had not had my neck broken at C4 and C5 i could have use it. I need a chair high enough to support my neck when i am using my computer for long hours. I gave it to my grandson for a gaming chair,he was thrilled. So we both won i didn't have to send it back and he is happy. It says high back,but i am 5'11" inches and my head goes over the top of it. I hope this helps someone decide. The design and the quality of this chair is really excellent. I should mention the assembly of this chair is really very easy. It is a quality chair well worth the money in my opinion. The reclining mechanism works very well. The inflatable lumbar support is a nice low budget addition to this chair. If you don't need constant neck support as i do i would recommend this chair. It is an excellent product for the money.

reviews.title: Well worth the money.
reviews.comment: What a great chair! Comfortable, height adjustment works well and the lumbar support does as well. This was assembled inside 30 minutes from opening the box.
reviews.author: LaurenceAmazon Customer

reviews.title: Good chair, good price.
reviews.comment: Overall the chair met all expectations except for one. It was easy enough to assemblem and is quite comfortable. The lumbar support pump works great. I purchased the ivory color chair and my only complaint is that there is a weird pink smudge on the seat that I have not been able to remove with any household cleaning products. Its small and does not detract from the overall use of the chair, it doesn't rub off on my skin or clothing, but this is a new chair and should not be stained. I don't want the hassle of returning so I will live with it. Maybe it will fade over time.
reviews.author: Jeannie W.

reviews.title: This gaming chair is a game-changer!
reviews.comment: The ergonomic design with lumbar support keeps me comfortable during long sessions, while the adjustable armrests and reclining feature allow perfect customization. The breathable mesh material prevents overheating, and the sturdy build ensures durability. The vibrant colors and sleek aesthetic make it a standout in my gaming setup. Assembly was straightforward, and the chair feels premium despite its affordable price. Guests always compliment its modern look. Whether for intense gaming or casual use, it’s a must-have for any gamer. Highly recommend for those seeking comfort, style, and functionality in one package!
reviews.author: Sherry D

reviews.title: Great chair
reviews.comment: A month or more in and I love the is chair. Durable and comfortable. No complaints. I work at desk all day and back issues were starting to be an issue and this has helped.
